_comment: DatoCMS 'Figure' block model. Create it under Settings → Blocks library with these fields, or import with the DatoCMS CMA client (see README). Lesson pages add it to their modular content field.
name: Figure

fields.label: Open challenge
fields.hint: Which challenge opens first (1–5). Leave empty to start on the idle tour.

fields.label: Caption override
fields.hint: Replaces the caption under the card. Leave empty to keep the figure's own.

render: <ws-figure name="{figure_name}" challenge="{preset_challenge}" caption="{caption_override}" theme="{theme}"></ws-figure> plus <script type="module" src="https://YOUR-VERCEL-DEPLOYMENT.vercel.app/{figure_name}.js"></script>
